title: Vitamin-Rich Vigorously Greekish Corned Beef Bowl
description: A post-workout bowl dish featuring corned beef, onions, and bell peppers in a winey, molten sauce served in a dolsot stone bowl.

ingredients.name: Red wine
ingredients.notes: Cooked down to reduce alcohol content.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the corned beef until browned on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the corned beef to a bain-marie with the wine and balsamic vinegar, and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced and the beef is tender.
While the beef is cooking, sauté the onion and bell pepper in the skillet until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.

To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the corned beef in the bottom of the dolsot stone bowl, then top with the sautéed onion and bell pepper mixture, and finally with a dollop of Greek yogurt (if using).
